INFOBLOX_CA_CERTIFICATE.title: INFOBLOX_CA_CERTIFICATE
INFOBLOX_CA_CERTIFICATE.description: The path to the CA certificate (PEM encoded)

INFOBLOX_DNS_VIEW.title: INFOBLOX_DNS_VIEW
INFOBLOX_DNS_VIEW.description: The view for the TXT records (Default: External)

INFOBLOX_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: INFOBLOX_POLLING_INTERVAL
INFOBLOX_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

INFOBLOX_PORT.title: INFOBLOX_PORT
INFOBLOX_PORT.description: The port for the infoblox grid manager  (Default: 443)

INFOBLOX_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: INFOBLOX_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
INFOBLOX_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60)

INFOBLOX_SSL_VERIFY.title: INFOBLOX_SSL_VERIFY
INFOBLOX_SSL_VERIFY.description: Whether or not to verify the TLS certificate  (Default: true)

INFOBLOX_TTL.title: INFOBLOX_TTL
INFOBLOX_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)

INFOBLOX_WAPI_VERSION.title: INFOBLOX_WAPI_VERSION
INFOBLOX_WAPI_VERSION.description: The version of WAPI being used  (Default: 2.11)
